newsitem.title: FRANCE: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -June 26.
newsitem.headline: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -June 26.

text.p: News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising, Marketing, Media, the Internet and Brand-name Products.

CANNES - Bozell, the U.S. advertising group, is expected to announce soon a link with a network of similar size to itself, with the most likely candidates being France's Havas Advertising or U.S. True North, advertising and banking sources say.

PARIS - Diffusion Controle, which measures the circulation of the French press and magazines, picks 1996 circulation winners. Sports daily L'Equipe's circulation rose 8.85 percent to 371,607 copies in 1996, while weekly news magazine l'Evenement du Jeudi saw circulation rise 30.18 percent to 200,740 copies. Sports journals are popular, cooking magazines left aside. (Les Echos, La Tribune)

PARIS - French telephone operator France Telecom SA is offering to buy the French cable television activities operated by Compagnie Generale des Eaux on networks owned by France Telecom, newspaper Le Monde says. (Reuter)

PARIS - France Telecom's interest in Compagnie Generale des Eaux's (CGE) cable TV networks turns the negotiations between CGE and Time Warner Inc into an unexpected duel, and may upset CGE ally Canal Plus's interest in the affair. (Les Echos)
PARIS - ABSat signs accord with Compagnie Generale des Eaux under which nine of its 20 channels would be broadcast on the digital service offered by CGE's cable television unit.

BEIJING - The Chinese side of a troubled joint venture with Peugeot SA has vowed to continue car production along or with new partners if the French company pulls out, the Economic Daily says. (Reuter)
PARIS - French carmakers PSA Peugeot Citroen and Renault SA are preparing to unveil an automatic transmission that they developed jointly as part of a drive to cut production costs.(Reuter)
